requirement_text: Publish an annual slavery and human trafficking statement, board-approved, describing steps taken to prevent forced labour in operations and supply chains.
applicability: Commercial organisations with turnover of GBP 36m or more
penalties: No fixed financial penalty; High Court injunction, unlimited fine for contempt, reputational damage

requirement_text: Public buyers must exclude suppliers with modern slavery convictions or findings; bidders must be able to show supply chain controls.
applicability: Companies bidding for UK public contracts
penalties: Exclusion and debarment from public contracts

requirement_text: Producers and importers are strictly liable for damage caused by a defective product, whether or not they were negligent.
applicability: Producers, own-branders and importers into the UK
penalties: Unlimited damages for death, personal injury and property damage; 10-year long-stop

requirement_text: Only place safe products on the market; keep traceability records and notify authorities of unsafe products.
applicability: Producers and distributors of consumer products in the UK
penalties: Criminal prosecution: unlimited fines and up to 12 months imprisonment; recall orders

regulation: EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD, 2024/1760)
requirement_text: Identify, prevent, mitigate and remedy adverse human rights and environmental impacts across the chain of activities; embed due diligence in policies, run a complaints procedure and monitor effectiveness.
applicability: Very large EU and non-EU companies with EU turnover above the thresholds; phased in from 2028
penalties: Fines of at least 5% of net worldwide turnover; civil liability for damages

requirement_text: Products made with forced labour may not be placed on or exported from the EU market; authorities investigate on a risk basis and operators must be able to show the supply chain.
applicability: All economic operators placing products on the EU market
penalties: Withdrawal of products from the market, border detention and disposal; national penalties

requirement_text: Economic operators must ensure products are safe, keep technical documentation and notify unsafe products through Safety Gate.
applicability: Manufacturers, importers and distributors of consumer products in the EU
penalties: Member State fines (up to 4% of annual turnover in several states); recalls and sales bans

requirement_text: Strict liability for defective products, now including software; courts can order disclosure of evidence and presume defect in complex cases.
applicability: Manufacturers, importers and online platforms for products placed on the EU market after December 2026
penalties: Compensation for death, injury, property damage and data loss; no liability cap

regulation: US Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act (UFLPA)
requirement_text: Rebuttable presumption that goods made wholly or partly in Xinjiang, or by listed entities, use forced labour; importers must show full supply chain tracing and clear evidence to obtain release.
applicability: All importers of goods into the US
penalties: Detention, exclusion or seizure of goods at the border; civil penalties

requirement_text: Goods mined, produced or manufactured with forced labour are prohibited from entry; CBP issues withhold release orders and findings.
applicability: All importers of goods into the US
penalties: Detention, seizure and forfeiture of goods; civil penalties

regulation: California Transparency in Supply Chains Act (SB 657)
requirement_text: Disclose on the company website efforts to eradicate slavery and human trafficking: verification, audits, certification, internal accountability and training.
applicability: Retailers and manufacturers doing business in California with worldwide revenue above USD 100m
penalties: Injunctive relief by the California Attorney General; no fine

regulation: US state product liability law and Consumer Product Safety Act
requirement_text: Strict product liability in tort for defective products; CPSA requires reporting of substantial product hazards to the CPSC within 24 hours.
applicability: Manufacturers, importers, distributors and retailers selling in the US
penalties: Compensatory and punitive damages; CPSC civil penalties above USD 100,000 per violation

regulation: Canada Fighting Against Forced Labour and Child Labour in Supply Chains Act
requirement_text: File an annual report to the Minister describing steps taken to prevent and reduce the risk of forced and child labour in the supply chain.
applicability: Entities listed in Canada, or doing business in Canada with assets above CAD 20m or 250 employees
penalties: Fines of up to CAD 250,000 for failing to report or for false reports

requirement_text: Goods mined, manufactured or produced wholly or in part by forced labour cannot be imported into Canada.
applicability: All importers of goods into Canada
penalties: Detention and seizure of goods at the border
